title: NoiseFormer -- Noise Diffused Symmetric Attention Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2601.11619v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Transformer architecture has been very successful long runner in the field of Deep Learning (DL) and Large Language Models (LLM) because of its powerful attention-based learning and parallel-natured architecture. As the models grow gigantic in terms of memory footprint, difficulties in fitting the model on a device like a GPU or an AI accelerator give rise to the need for multiple computing devices thereby escalating the computing cost. This increased training/inference cost paved the way for optimizing the memory footprint of the models in terms of activation memory as well as model size reduction. In this paper, we start analyzing one of the Attention architectures aimed at model-size reduction called Symmetric Dot-Product Attention (referred to as Symmetric Attention) and propose a novel unified model architecture called Noise Diffused Symmetric Attention Transformer to enhance the model's performance. translated_abstract: Transformer架构凭借其强大的基于注意力的学习能力和天然并行的架构特性，一直是深度学习（DL）和大语言模型（LLM）领域中长期成功的架构。随着模型在内存占用方面变得日益庞大，将模型完整装 入GPU或AI加速器等单一设备变得困难，需要使用多个计算设备，从而推高了计算成本。这种不断上升的训练/推理成本促使人们从激活内存和模型规模两方面对模型的内存占用进行优化。在本文中，我们首先分析了一种旨在缩减模型规模的注意力架构——对称点积注意力（Symmetric Dot-Product Attention，简称对称注意力），并提出了一种名为噪声扩散对称注意力Transformer的新型统一模型架构，以提升模型性能。在保持（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的噪声扩散对称注意力Transformer架构，在基于对称点积注意力实现模型规模缩减的同时，进一步提升模型的性能表现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel Noise Diffused Symmetric Attention Transformer architecture that builds upon Symmetric Dot-Product Attention for model-size reduction while enhancing overall model performance.
